semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company specializes in engineering plastics, particularly PTFE, which can be relevant for semiconductor applications but is not exclusively focused on semiconductor materials.
summary: IL Woong Platech Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of semi-finished thermoplastics, particularly PTFE products such as sheets, rods, tubes, and gaskets. The company has a strong focus on quality and customer satisfaction, providing specialized products tailored to customer requirements.
capabilities: Manufacturing of PTFE sheets and films
Production of engineering plastics including PEEK and PVDF

regional_presence.Korea: The company was founded in Seoul, Korea, and has been a local market leader since 1988.
